name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up
steps: Lie faceup with the bell held above one shoulder, the same-side foot planted and the opposite arm and leg angled out.
Press through the planted foot and roll onto your free elbow, then rise onto your palm.
Lift your hips and draw the straight leg underneath you until its knee is under your hip.
Lift your hand, square your legs into a half-kneeling lunge and rise to stand with the bell overhead.
Reverse the sequence to the floor, lower the bell with both hands and switch sides.
tips: Keep the bell stacked over your shoulder and steady it before moving to the next support.
Move deliberately from one distinct position to the next rather than rushing through the sequence.
